cards.back: Model quality is bounded by data quality, coverage, and quantity—engineering datasets is as important as picking architectures.
Dirty or mislabeled data hurts more as you scale; curation and deduplication often beat blindly adding volume.
Representing the slices, locales, and edge cases your app will see—not just average-case examples.
Model collapse, bias amplification, and eval leakage if synthetic trains and tests overlap—validate with real slices.
Train a smaller model on outputs/trajectories from a larger teacher—ties to finetuning and cost (Chapter 7).
Foundation-model outputs are harder to label consistently than fixed-class tasks—need rubrics and inter-annotator agreement.
